nom: SOME BY MI AHA BHA PHA 30 Day Miracle Exfoliating Cica Toner Pads

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or oily-acne prone skin report reduced oiliness, less congestion, and cleared breakouts, though one describes an oily film residue left on the skin.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive or acne-prone sensitive skin are split: several report gentle exfoliation with no irritation or purging, while one with sensitive skin reports jawline and cheek damage and recommends against use for sensitive skin.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report reduced pore size, help with age spots, and clearer skin after congestion and closed comedones.
segments.mature: A reviewer in her mid-40s with combined dryness and oiliness reports the pads leave skin balanced, smoother and less oily without over-drying.

concerns.aging: One mid-40s reviewer reports the pads help balance oil and improve texture as part of an anti-aging routine, and another with combination skin reports visible reduction in age spots.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with severely sensitive, acne-prone skin reports the pads keep overall redness and inflammation down; no other reviewer discusses redness specifically.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer reports the product damaged the skin around the jawline and lower cheeks; another reports the pads exfoliate strongly but without burning, suggesting mixed tolerance depending on skin sensitivity.
concerns.spots: Reviewers report improvement in dark spots, hyperpigmentation from KP, and age spots after regular use.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report clearer skin, fewer closed comedones, and pimples kept at bay; two reviewers report new breakouts on the forehead, chin, or jawline after use.
concerns.oiliness: Multiple reviewers report reduced oiliness and a more balanced, less congested feel, though one reviewer reports an oily film residue left on the face.

aspects.libelle: Noticeable tea tree or peppermint scent
Causes new breakouts for some users
Good value for an affordable exfoliant

extraits.texte: Bought these to help with minor texture on my forehead. 30 days later... the texture is visibly worse and it has broken me out. My forehead, chin and my cheeks are all breaking out because of this product. Was super excited to try it, but super let down.
Do not recommend for sensitive skin, damaged the skin around my jawline/lower cheeks. BUT it definitely exfoliated so i would recommend for those who do not have sensitive skin

extraits.titre: Works for evening skin texture due to congested pores
extraits.texte: These are great! I have only used the pads for 4 days (daily after cleansing) and I'm already seeing results. My skin is smoother, brighter, less congested, and less oily. I'm in my mid-40s and still deal with acne. But unlike in my teens/20s/30s when my skin was just always an oil slick, I have both dryness and oiliness at the same time now. Finding the right balance for oil control and anti-aging is tricky. After using these pads, my skin feels balanced and soft, and not too dried out. I love that they include a small set of tweezers in the cap of the product to keep the product sanitary. There is a slight fragrance from the tea tree oil and peppermint oil, which doesn't bother me, and smells rather refreshing.

These pads literally were a turning point in my skin care routine! If you have severely sensitive or acne prome skin, I highly recommend this product to help combat the irritation, inflammation, redness, etc. that comes with fighting acne. These pads keep my overall redness down and oiliness down as well. I switch off ever other day with my tret and had no issues with purging.

Been using twice a day after washing my face for about 2 weeks. I'm 34 with large pores and combination skin. This product has visibly reduced my pores and helped with age spots. Obsessed is an understatement!!

I have combination/acne/sensitive skin. My face was so congested for the past 2 and a half months...I couldn't get rid of the acne/closed comedones on my cheeks and chin until I used this! It was so gentle on my skin it didn't cause any irritation. I've been using it for a week and a half and ive seen a huge difference. The bha/aha really do exfoliate your skin but it isn't harsh like others. If your skin is sensitive like mine give this a try!

These are great toner pads, they have really cleared my skin up. But ive noticed some acne along my chin and jawline, which i never usually get. Although, im pretty sure its because ive been eating sugar recently, but just keep in mind to watch out for that overall area. I have oily-acne prone skin and these little pads worked wonders for me. Also the scent is quite stong.
